name: s81engc_ctl_s-hl2-COMMIT
purpose: S81 Engram hardened own-state leaf ot_engc_ctl_s on the die-assigned v19_engram_hl pins/outline

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_engc_ctl_s u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/engram/rso_candidate/ot_engc_hl_leaves.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81engc_ctl_s/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81engc_ctl_s/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81engc_ctl_s --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_engc_ctl_s  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Die decision 10-14 06:36 (el1013-s81-engram.log): the Engram parent's own state (930 data + 16 reset flops) is hardened into leaves so the parent holds no flop: three same-edge return relay leaves at the bank source pins (256/256/64) and one control leaf beside IO_R1 (8 conditioners, status/transit/release pipes, registered ACK). Parent dsfd_engram_c_hl, rtl/dsrom_sys/engram/rso_candidate/{dsfd_engram_c_hl,ot_engc_hl_leaves}.sv. Die r6 16:26 (v19_engram_hl, main eb466f470): ot_engc_ctl_s outline 43.2 x 17.28 and pins assigned by the die (io_tcl); ctl split into ot_engc_ctl_x / ot_engc_ctl_s, rr1 = ot_engc_rr256w, rr64 conditions the async die reset itself.
